file_name: Questionnaire - Merchant Wealth Partners - minority investment in Ironbark Financial Group.pdf

questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if any business controlled or managed by Merchant Wealth Partners are close competitors to Ironbark Financial Group and there are not many alternatives, or if one is a major supplier to competitors of the other.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Merchant Wealth Partners and/or Ironbark Financial Group.
